services.desc: Drawing is something I’ve done for as long as I can remember. My report cards from kindergarten and first grade begin mentioning my enthusiasm for art, which those teachers wanted to encourage. However, that soon changed, and the teachers were suggesting that I needed to spend more time on my reading and arithmetic and less time drawing-which was true. In high school, I opted for art classes instead of study halls. By my senior year I was able to fit two art classes into every day. That and the fact that I had a remarkable teacher led to an art school scholarship after graduation. blurb: Drawing inspiration from intense examination of the contemporary social landscape, Clint Brown’s exhibition A Life of Drawing, displays both Brown’s mastery of the medium and continuing relevance. Across a range of charcoal and conté drawings, Brown confronts pressing issues such as homelessness, environmental degradation, and epidemic disease, as well as universal constants of love and death.
